page_title: BET 1-0 GRA | Betis v Granada CF 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+8' The corner is swung in but Granada CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+8' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Granada CF have been awarded a corner kick.
90+6' A quickly taken corner by Betis.

90+5' Nabil Fekir (Betis) latches on to a lofted pass from the free kick and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box. His effort towards the roof of the net is saved by the excellent Augusto Batalla.
90+4' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) for a tough tackle.
90+2' Isco (Betis) sees a yellow card from Guillermo Cuadra after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' The substitution is prepared. Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bruno Mendez.
88' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
88' Guillermo Cuadra blows the whistle, Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) is penalised for a foul. Betis are awarded the free kick.
87' Here is a change. Gonzalo Villar is going off and Alexandre Medina gives the last tactical orders to Martin Hongla (Granada CF).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) comes onto the pitch for Myrto Uzuni.
84' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Granada CF players look gutted.
83' Wait! Referee Guillermo Cuadra has indicated he is going to review the Granada CF goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
82' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
76' 1 - 0 Isco (Betis) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
76' Isco (Betis) works the corner short.
75' Isco (Betis) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

75' Luiz Henrique (Betis) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.

73' Assane Diao (Betis) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
71' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
70' Isco (Betis) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
70' A clumsy foul by Nabil Fekir (Betis) and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle. Granada CF are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
69' That's the end of the game for Willian Jose, who is replaced by Nabil Fekir (Betis).
68' Alexandre Medina decides to make a substitution. Sergio Ruiz will be replaced by Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF).
68' Substitution. Jose Callejon did his best and is replaced by Matias Arezo (Granada CF).
65' The referee gives a yellow card to Assane Diao (Betis).
64' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
61' Superb touch by Willian Jose (Betis) as he receives a precise pass into the box, but the goalkeeper stops the ball as it heads towards the top of the net. Brilliant save!
60' Assane Diao (Betis) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Guillermo Cuadra who sees an offensive foul. Granada CF have a free kick.
58' Willian Jose (Betis) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Augusto Batalla makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the top left corner.
57' Willian Jose (Betis) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
57' The ball is out of play. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner.
57' Luiz Henrique (Betis) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Betis.

56' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Rui Silva keeps the ball out.
56' Granada CF earn a free kick.
55' Booking. Sokratis (Betis) receives a caution from the referee.
55' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
54' The attendance is 50197.
54' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

53' Assane Diao (Betis) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Betis have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
53' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

52' Sokratis (Betis) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Betis earn a corner.
50' Problems for Manuel Pellegrini as Aitor Ruibal is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Pablo Busto Gonzalez (Betis) replaces him.
48' The game is interrupted now, Aitor Ruibal (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
48' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Rui Silva intercepts the ball.
47' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
46' Luiz Henrique (Betis) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Augusto Batalla, who smothers the ball.
46' The whistle blows and Guillermo Cuadra starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+3' Marc Roca (Betis) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle after Abner (Betis) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Granada CF will take a free kick near the side line.
44' The main referee, Guillermo Cuadra, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Augusto Batalla (Granada CF) is given a yellow card for dissent.
43' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
43' Isco (Betis) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.

39' That didn't go as planned! Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Rui Silva, who easily kept it out.
37' Poor challenge! Isco (Betis) is penalised for tripping and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle. Granada CF win a free kick.
35' A player from Granada CF commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Betis win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
34' Assane Diao (Betis) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
33' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) gets booked for the first time in this match.
31' Assane Diao (Betis) commits a foul and Guillermo Cuadra immediately signals a free kick.
31' Betis work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
31' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing. The ball is out of play. Betis win a corner kick.
30' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Betis.
30' Augusto Batalla (Granada CF) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
29' Augusto Batalla (Granada CF) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

28' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Betis can continue in their attacking effort.
28' Luiz Henrique (Betis) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. Betis get a corner.
26' Marc Roca (Betis) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Granada CF are awarded a free kick.
25' Kamil Piatkowski (Granada CF) jumps into a tackle and Guillermo Cuadra signals a foul. A free kick to Betis.
24' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
24' Half-chance! Luiz Henrique (Betis) plays a pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla reacts well to snuff out the attack.
23' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
23' Isco (Betis) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
23' Assane Diao (Betis) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Augusto Batalla is alert and denies him.
21' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
20' Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight and sees a foul from Aitor Ruibal (Betis). It's a free kick to Granada CF in a dangerous position.
19' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
19' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul after Sokratis (Betis) hacks down one of his opponents. Granada CF have been awarded a free kick.
19' Manuel Pellegrini is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Ayoze Perez suffers an injury and Assane Diao (Betis) comes on.
16' A cross into the box from Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) is cleared.
15' Ayoze Perez (Betis) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
13' Ayoze Perez (Betis) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
13' Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Guillermo Cuadra didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

12' Luiz Henrique (Betis) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
8' Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul. Betis get a free kick.

5' Luiz Henrique (Betis) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Granada CF, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
4' Granada CF are ruled offside.
3' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) is penalised for holding. Guillermo Cuadra signals a set piece. It's a free kick to Betis, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

2' The game is interrupted. Lucas Boye (Granada CF) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Betis have a free kick.
1' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for an infringement. That's a free kick to Betis.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Betis will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Guillermo Cuadra.
